summary: Prepare for the PECB GDPR Certified Data Protection Officer exam with practical training in DPO duties, impact assessments, and compliance monitoring.
audienceIntro: This five-day GDPR course is for professionals who advise on personal data protection, maintain GDPR compliance, or are preparing to take on DPO responsibilities.
prerequisites: To attend, you need a fundamental understanding of the GDPR and comprehensive knowledge of data protection requirements.
